name: Venom Battlecast
description: Venom: The last hit inflicts a Bleed Vulnerability Debuff, increasing the potency of future Bleed Effects for 16s.

innate.name: Symbiotic Bond
innate.desc: For each unique Buff on the Champion, inflict an indefinite Bleed Vulnerability Passive, increasing the potency of future Bleed Effects. Max Buffs: 6.

abilities.name: Ravenous Strike
abilities.desc: For each unique Buff on the Champion, Bleed Debuffs inflicted by hits landed against a Bleeding Opponent gain duration and Ability Accuracy.

abilities.name: Merciless Strike
abilities.desc: For each unique Buff on the Champion, hits landed against a Bleeding Opponent gain Critical Damage Rating and Critical Rating.

attributes.name: Fury, Precision, and Cruelty Up
attributes.desc: +[2 - 4]% Fury, Precision and Cruelty Buff Potency.

attributes.name: Mutation and Cookin' Duration Down
attributes.desc: -[8 - 16]% Mutation Buff Duration and Cookin' Meter Charge Timer.

name: Thor Battlecast
description: Thor: The last hit grants an Aptitude Buff, increasing the potency of Fury, Armor Up and Precision Buffs for 16s.

innate.name: Asgardian Aptitudes
innate.desc: The first time an indefinite Fury, Precision or Armor Up Buff are gained during the fight while an Aptitude Buff is active, gain an indefinite Aptitude Passive increasing the potency of Fury, Armor Up and Precision. When all 3 Aptitudes Passives are active, gain an indefinite Intensify Buff, increasing the potency of future Buffs.

abilities.name: Ragnarok's Vigor
abilities.desc: Gaining a Fury Buff grants a non-stacking Vigor Passive, increasing damage dealt to the Opponent from all sources. When gaining an indefinite Fury Buff, replace the Vigor with a Vigor Buff, increasing damage dealt to the Opponent from all sources. This Buff refreshes whenever another Buff is gained.

abilities.name: Valhallan Fortitude
abilities.desc: Gaining a Armor Up Buff grants a non-stacking Fortitude Passive, reducing damage from all sources. When gaining an indefinite Armor Up Buff, replace the Fortitude with a Fortitude Buff, reducing damage from all sources. This Buff refreshes whenever another Buff is gained.

name: Ms. Marvel Battlecast
description: Ms. Marvel: The final hit grants a 12s Precision Buff increasing Critical Rating.

innate.name: Marvelous Kree Warrior
innate.desc: Hits that deal True Damage or have True Strike grant Spirit Gauge. Nova, Sersi: Activating True Damage or True Strike Buffs pauses the Relic's Precision Buff for 6s.

abilities.name: Stellar Defender
abilities.desc: When an Opponent's Auto-Block or an Evade fails to trigger due to a reason other than chance, they are dealt a burst of Direct Damage. Nova: For each Fury or True Strike Buff, Special Attacks have a chance to grant an Unblockable Buff.

abilities.name: Air Force Dynamo
abilities.desc: Hits that deal True Damage or have True Strike gain Critical Rating. Sersi: While a True Damage Buff is active, Special Attack 2 gains Critical Rating. A True Damage Buff is consumed after the attack ends.

name: Gamora Battlecast
description: Gamora: Final hit grants a Stoicism Buff, increasing the Ability Accuracy of other Buffs by for 10s.

innate.name: Artificially Enhanced Physiology
innate.desc: Whenever a Fury or Cruelty Buff fails due to chance, gain 1% increased Fury and Cruelty Ability Accuracy for the rest of the fight. Gamora, Hyperion, King Groot: Also triggers on failure due to Ability Accuracy but increases Ability Accuracy by 10% instead. Personal Fury Charges count for this ability, and all Ability Accuracy increases from this Relic apply to them as flat increases, but at half potency.

abilities.name: Master Of 83.4%
abilities.desc: Whenever one or more Fury or Cruelty Buffs trigger, chance to gain a single Expertise Buff increasing the potency of Fury, Cruelty, Pierce, and Precision Buffs. Chance increased if the triggering Buff's base chance was less than 100%. Gamora, Hyperion: Duration increased.

abilities.name: Godslayer Proficiency
abilities.desc: Fury and Cruelty Buffs last longer for each other Buff of that type activated previously this fight. Gamora, King Groot: While Godslayer or Malice cooldowns are active, increase Spirit Gain Rate.

attributes.name: Fury & Cruelty AA Up
attributes.desc: +[4 - 8]% Fury and Cruelty Buff Ability Accuracy.

name: The Cosmic Egg
description: Howard the Duck: The first hit activates all of the Symbiote Buffs locked in the RNA Bank, but the RNA Bank can only store 6 Buffs.

innate.name: RNA Mutation
innate.desc: Increase the duration of all Buffs activated from the RNA Bank by 10%.

abilities.name: Toxic Armor Chance
abilities.desc: Increase the Ability Accuracy of Toxic Armor Buffs by 34%.

attributes.name: RNA Fury
attributes.desc: At the start of a Fight add 1 Fury to the RNA Bank if there are currently none in it. The first time this Fury is activated each Quest increase its duration by 20%.

attributes.name: RNA Precison
attributes.desc: At the start of a Fight add 1 Precison to the RNA Bank if there are currently none in it. The first time this Precison is activated each Quest increase its duration by 20%.

attributes.name: RNA Power Rate
attributes.desc: At the start of a Fight add 1 Power Rate to the RNA Bank if there are currently none in it. The first time this Power Rate is activated each Quest increase its duration by 20%.

attributes.name: RNA Armor Up
attributes.desc: At the start of a Fight add 1 Armor Up to the RNA Bank if there are currently none in it. The first time this Armor Up is activated each Quest increase its duration by 20%.

attributes.name: RNA Regeneration
attributes.desc: At the start of a Fight add 1 Regeneration to the RNA Bank if there are currently none in it. The first time this Regeneration is activated each Quest increase its duration by 20%.

attributes.name: RNA Perfect Block
attributes.desc: At the start of a Fight add 1 Perfect Block to the RNA Bank if there are currently none in it. The first time this Perfect Block is activated each Quest increase its duration by 20%.

name: Vision Battlecast
description: Vision: Inflict a Smother Debuff lasting 12 seconds. Whenever a Smothered Opponent heals while Heal Blocked, deal a burst of Energy Damage.

innate.name: Android Avenger
innate.desc: When the Opponent has been prevented from healing a percentage of their Max Health due to Heal Block effects, inflict an indefinite Torment Passive, increasing the duration of Damaging Effects. Max stacks: 3.

abilities.name: Cauterizing Strikes
abilities.desc: While the Opponent has less than 40% Health, Heal Block Debuffs and Heal Block Passives gain increased duration.

abilities.name: A.I. Tactician
abilities.desc: Inflicting a Heal Block Effect on an Opponent with a Regeneration Effect, will trigger a Fury Passive. Increase Fury Potency if the Heal Block is Passive.

attributes.name: DOT Potency Up
attributes.desc: +[4 - 8]% Incinerate, Poison, Shock, Plasma Effect Potency.

attributes.name: Block Proficiency Up
attributes.desc: +[3.2 - 6.4]% Block Proficiency if Opponent is Heal Blocked.

name: Hulkbuster Battlecast
description: Hulkbuster: Inflict a Shock Vulnerability Debuff, increasing the potency of Shock Effects for 12 seconds.

innate.name: High Voltage Upgrades
innate.desc: When the Opponent has been afflicted with a total of 10 Shock Effects, inflict a non-stacking Energy Vulnerability Passive, lowering Energy Resistance for 15 seconds. Max stacks: 3.

abilities.name: Shock Repulsors
abilities.desc: The next Shock Debuff gains duration and potency.

abilities.name: Hulk Inhibitor
abilities.desc: While you have 3+ Shock Effect on the Opponent, inflict a Suppression Passive, lowering Combat Power Rate.

name: Sentinel Battlecast
description: Sentinel: The final hit inflicts a Incinerate Vulnerability Passive for 14s.

innate.name: Mutant Hunter Prototype
innate.desc: Inflicting an Incinerate Debuff while the Opponent is already Incinerated grants Spirit Gauge. Green Goblin, Sentinel: Gain Incinerate Debuff potency.

abilities.name: Experimental ISO Armaments
abilities.desc: Lower the Attack Rating of Incinerated Opponents. Green Goblin: increased flat Incinerate Ability Accuracy for each Cunning Charge. Additionally, gain a Cunning Charge when an Incinerate fails to trigger due to chance.

abilities.name: We Are Sentinel
abilities.desc: Basic Attacks gain a chance to pause an Incinerate Debuff. Sentinel: At max Analysis Charges this Striker gains Incinerate Vulnerability Passive duration.

name: Green Goblin Battlecast
description: Green Goblin: Grants a Power Efficiency Passive for 5s, decreasing the cost of Special Attacks.

innate.name: Arsenal Of Tricks
innate.desc: Whenever a Basic/Special Attack Power Drains the Opponent, chance to inflict a non-stacking Weakness Debuff lasting 7s. This ability is unaffected by Ability Accuracy. Green Goblin, Doctor Octopus, Vulture: 66% chance to inflict either an Incinerate or Poison Debuff, instead of the Weakness. Each deals damage over 7s.

abilities.name: Joy In One's Work
abilities.desc: Attacks that Power Drain the Opponent fill the Spirit Gauge. Green Goblin: Also grants charges needed to equalize Madness and Cunning. Doctor Octopus: Physics Research generates faster.

abilities.name: Attack The Heart
abilities.desc: Gain Debuff Ability Accuracy and duration. Green Goblin, Vulture: increase Bag of Tricks, Super Bomb, and Siphon Debuff Ability Accuracy, and personal Debuff duration.
